name: The Tailor's Fitting
summary: 'Measure twice, cut once' on a cutting table: a tape measures every metric, chalk marks the one that doesn't fit, and only after the human's call do the shears make one clean cut.
look: A warm linen cutting table seen top-down, with a length of teal twill wool, an amber tape measure with ink ticks, coral tailor's chalk and pins, and cream paper swing tags. Precise and tailored rather than rustic.

components.name: Tape measure
components.role: ticks labelled with metrics; the Acme mark is its metal end

components.name: Wool length
components.role: teal twill fabric; the release before it ships

components.name: Tailor's chalk
components.role: coral dotted line and X where a metric doesn't fit

components.name: Pins
components.role: hold the fix until the human decides

components.name: Swing tag
components.role: carries the anomaly, later the proverb

components.name: Shears + woven label
components.role: one clean cut as the ship; the stitched label carries the wordmark

motion.name: Tape unroll
motion.how: scaleX from the pinned metal end with a slight curl, power3.out 0.6 s, landing on the drop

motion.name: Chalk stroke
motion.how: dotted dash-draw over 0.4 s with seeded, deterministic chalk dust

motion.name: One cut
motion.how: shears travel the chalk line and the fabric splits by clip-path on a single expo.inOut beat (0.5 s)

story: Hook: a length of wool already cut jagged, the tape still tangled, and a swing tag reading 'cut 16:00 · measured 17:40'. Reveal: on the drop the tape unrolls from its metal end (the Acme mark) and a woven 'Acme Pulse' label drops in. Proof: the tape measures each metric with teal ticks; at Checkout chalk marks an X, pins go in, and the tag reads 'Checkout conv. −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231'; the human taps Roll back because nothing is cut until they say so. CTA: one clean cut, 'Caught before customers noticed.', tag 'Measure twice. Ship once.', Start free.
adapt: Put your own checks on the tape's ticks (tests, budgets, limits, policies) and let the one cut be your product's irreversible action: a deploy, a payment, a send.

references.note: how fashion designers read a tape measure

fit.risk: Craft textures can feel off-category for software; keep it precise and tailored, never rustic.

best_for: any SaaS with an irreversible action
